notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Grinding Station and Kolodin triggers
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Kolodin trigger, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.
